inspection.temporalInspection: Every actual desktop and phone WebM decoded to chronological frames every two seconds; all frames inspected. Original journey PNGs inspected separately for full text and composition.
inspection.limitations: Chromium emulation only. Physical phone, camera/native spatial, hardware, assistive technology and owner acceptance not claimed. Sub-two-second motion quality is not proven by frame sampling.

findings.observation: The phone retains green Same Voyage in sync during actual disconnection while the lower transfer region says Connection interrupted. Those simultaneous status messages contradict each other and can falsely reassure a user that the connected view is current.

Account-recovery explanation and Create Account/Forgot Password links appear white on pale parchment. The reduced Journal fallback also renders canonical Chart status and search instructions white on parchment; related dark controls lose readable label contrast. These are live instructions and available links, not decorative content.

The read-only Chart correctly says arrival controls remain on the controlling device, but later still instructs Use Confirm arrival myself when no such control exists here. The leading read-only explanation limits impact, but the fallback instruction should name the controlling device.

lensDebtOutcome.judgment: Meaningful rendered Lens outcome observed; do not carry unchanged-baseline waiver.
lensDebtOutcome.observation: Selecting Chronicle Lens opens a distinct canonical Guided View dialog for A message between worlds, showing the published Captain note clue and an actual Inspect state. Camera-free availability is explained. Close restores the companion and Return to Chronicle reaches the same Voyage.

positiveObservations: Connection is contextual to the active Chronicle: one scan-first dialog keeps the book behind it, has a code fallback, explains same-account sign-in and expiry, and offers Continue the Chronicle.
Purpose choices explain tasks and produce visibly distinct Lens, Chart, readable complete Journal passage/letter and artifact outcomes. The same named Voyage stays above every purpose.

The receive offer remains separate from the original readable letter until acceptance; accepted content becomes the actual released Chart with its objective. The sender visibly distinguishes ready to receive, arrival and opened states in the temporal recording.

Cancel and decline preserve the readable source view. Expired code explains obtaining a fresh code. The crew display starts empty, receives only deliberately shared released content, and offers authorized return to personal Journal.
Current-surface revocation replaces the protected Journal with a reconnect explanation, retry and contextual return; session-ended navigation shows the account entry surface.

Normal and reduced recordings preserve the same purpose outcomes; recorded transition observations remain below the selected five-second feedback budget. Native and physical smoothness remain unclaimed.
